purpose: stress-test the Needs Factory pipeline without contaminating PROD evidence
hard_rules: No synthetic value may be copied into EVIDENCE_REGISTRY, an evidence addendum, promoted PROD need, call-compliance finding, project narrative, target-size justification or public report.
Every twin artifact filename and internal record must carry NON_EVIDENCE or TEST_TWIN classification.
PROD and TEST_TWIN evidence IDs use disjoint namespaces: EV-* is reserved for PROD; TWIN-* is reserved for synthetic fixtures.
Any pipeline stage that cannot preserve provenance separation fails closed.
A successful synthetic test proves engine behavior only; it never upgrades empirical confidence in AI4WORK STEP.
stress_tests: ingestion with missing values and invalid category combinations
high perceived need but high measured self-efficacy
low AI adoption with no reported skills barrier
solution-leakage detection against quarantined AI PRACTIC/AI WORKFLOW design fields
scale inference guardrail preventing synthetic interest from validating PROD 160 or 80/40/40
adversarial QA confirming TEST_TWIN values cannot appear in final PROD narrative
release_gate: PROD release is independent of TEST_TWIN pass. TEST_TWIN contamination of any PROD artifact is a hard FAIL.
